edges.reason: msg.sender returned by _msgSender flows into _transfer as the from address for user-initiated transfers
manualswap authorization is a bare comparison of _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1, so the privileged wallet can drain contract tokens without ownership
manualsend authorization is a bare comparison of _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1, letting the fee wallet sweep all contract ETH
openTrading is protected only by the onlyOwner modifier which compares _msgSender() to _owner
setBots is owner-restricted through onlyOwner and can blacklist arbitrary addresses
setCooldownEnabled is owner-restricted through onlyOwner and controls the cooldown behavior
renounceOwnership depends on _msgSender() matching _owner through onlyOwner
Context._msgSender simply returns msg.sender
_msgSender() supplies the from address in transfer and transferFrom call chains
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance accounting
cooldown[to] is set to block.timestamp + 30 seconds, making the buy path timestamp dependent
block.timestamp is passed as the uniswap swap deadline, making the swap execution timestamp dependent
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline during trading initialization
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance is positive
_transfer delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer
_transfer indirectly mutates _rOwned through the _tokenTransfer chain
_transfer reads the owner-controlled bots blacklist to block transfers
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping governed by block.timestamp
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to bypass cooldown and fee logic
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on pair buys
_transfer reads swapEnabled to decide whether to auto-swap
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled to decide whether to apply the cooldown
_transfer writes _feeAddr2 to 10 before value computation
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call while token balances are being updated; lockTheSwap only blocks same-contract re-entry
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 which can execute fallback code and re-enter the contract
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to set the router allowance
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
approve delegates to _approve
transfer calls _transfer
transferFrom calls _transfer with the supplied sender
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance

_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal for the token supply

_transferStandard calls _getValues for the amount breakdown
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee
_transferStandard subtracts from sender and adds to recipient in _rOwned using SafeMath
_takeTeam uses _getRate to convert team tokens to reflections
_takeTeam increases _rOwned of the contract address
_reflectFee reduces the total reflection supply _rTotal
_reflectFee accumulates _tFeeTotal
_getValues calls _getTValues
_getValues calls _getRValues
_getValues fetches the current reflection rate

openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair

openTrading enables automatic swaps via swapEnabled
openTrading enables the cooldown via cooldownEnabled
openTrading raises _maxTxAmount after liquidity is added
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH call forwarding the contract ETH balance
openTrading calls _approve for the router and the pair

delBot clears the bots mapping entry
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag

owner returns _owner

manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance

_feeAddr2 is used as the TeamFee argument inside _getValues/_getTValues

manualsend authorizes the caller against the stored _feeAddrWallet1 address

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to carry the caller/sender address into the core _transfer function
The to parameter only exists to carry the recipient address into the core _transfer function
The amount parameter is consumed entirely inside _transfer for limit checking and accounting
The tokenAmount parameter is only used to approve and swap tokens in swapTokensForEth
The amount parameter is only used as the ETH value forwarded by sendETHToFee
The tAmount parameter is only expanded by _getValues inside _transferStandard
The bots_ array only exists to populate the bots mapping inside setBots
The notbot address only exists to clear a blacklist entry inside delBot
The recipient parameter is only forwarded to _transfer from the transfer entry point
The sender parameter is only forwarded to _transfer and _approve from transferFrom
The spender parameter is only written into _allowances through approve/_approve
The local contract token balance is used solely as the swap input amount
The local contract ETH balance is used solely as the ETH amount forwarded to fees
The local path array is only constructed to be passed to the router swap call
The local current rate is only produced by _getRate and consumed by the reflection math
